blocks.text: Ash-Shaafee The One who Cures is from the Names found authentically in the Prophetic Sunnah. It is authentically recorded in the two Saheehs from 'Aa'ishah who said:

The Prophet ﷺ used to treat some of his wives by passing his right hand over the place of ailment and used to say, "O Allah, Lord of the people! Remove the harm and heal the patient, for You are The Healer. There is no cure except Your cure; healing that will leave behind no ailment."

The meaning of Ash-Shaafee is the One from whom comes the cure - curing the chests from doubt, uncertainties, envy, jealousy and other than those from the diseases of the heart. Curing the body from illnesses and defects and no one else is able to do this. There is no cure except His cure and no one can cure except Him. As Ibraaheem al-Khaleel said,
And when I am ill, it is He who cures me.
This means He alone is the One to cure, without partners. Due to this it is a must upon every adult to have firm belief that there is no one to cure except Allaah.

Due to this, from the best ways to Allaah in seeking a cure from illnesses and diseases is seeking nearness tawassul by singling Him out alone for Lordship and that the cure is in His Hand alone. There is no cure for anyone except by His permission. The command is His command, the creation is His creation. Everything is by His direction. What He willed happened and what He did not will, did not happen and there is no might nor strength except from Him.

This, the servant's belief and faith that The Shaafee The One to cure is Allaah alone and that the cure is in His Hand, does not prevent him from seeking beneficial means of therapy, treatment or taking beneficial medicines. There are many ahaadeeth from the Prophet ﷺ regarding treatment with the mention of beneficial good medicines and that does not negate reliance (tawakkul) upon Allaah or the belief that the cure is in His Hand.
Bukhaaree relates in his Saheeh from Aboo Hurayrah that the Prophet ﷺ said,
"There is no disease that Allah has created, except that He also has created its treatment."
In the Musnad (of Imaam Ahmad) Usaamah bin Shareek said, the Messenger of Allaah ﷺ said,
"Allaah did not send down a sickness except that He sent down its cure, whether a person knows it or not or is ignorant of it or not."
blocks.ref: Ahmad 4/278; Aboo Daawood 3855; Ibn Hibbaan 486; Al-Haakim 1/121 and others with an authentic chain

blocks.text: I ask Allaah the Mighty, the Lord of the people, the remover of harm, the One who cures without whom there is no cure except His, to cure our sick and the Muslims who are sick.

keyPoints: Ash-Shaafee is found authentically in the Sunnah, in the Prophet's ﷺ supplication: "Remove the harm and heal the patient, for You are The Healer."
Ash-Shaafee is the One from whom comes the cure: curing the chests from doubts, envy and the diseases of the heart, and curing the body from illnesses and defects.
There is no cure except His cure and no one can cure except Him, as Ibraaheem said: "And when I am ill, it is He who cures me."
From the best ways of seeking a cure is seeking nearness (tawassul) to Allaah by singling Him out for Lordship and affirming that the cure is in His Hand alone.
Believing that the cure is only from Allaah does not prevent seeking beneficial treatment and medicines, and that does not negate reliance (tawakkul) upon Allaah.

evidence.text: "O Allah, Lord of the people! Remove the harm and heal the patient, for You are The Healer. There is no cure except Your cure..."
And when I am ill, it is He who cures me.

recall.a: The One who Cures: the One from whom comes the cure, curing the chests from doubts and diseases of the heart and the body from illnesses and defects; no one else is able to do this.

recall.q: Which aayah of Ibraaheem does the author cite?
recall.a: "And when I am ill, it is He who cures me." [Shu'araa 26:80]

recall.q: Does believing Allaah alone cures prevent taking medicine?
recall.a: No. It does not prevent seeking beneficial therapy, treatment or medicines, and that does not negate reliance (tawakkul) upon Allaah.

recall.q: What did the Prophet ﷺ say about disease and its treatment (Bukhaaree, from Aboo Hurayrah)?
recall.a: "There is no disease that Allah has created, except that He also has created its treatment."
